definitionZh: CSS引用属性设定浏览器应如何将自动添加到HTML q元素的引号或者使用CSS内容属性的开放引号或近引号添加(或省略使用不开放引号或近引号).
sourceDefinition: The CSS quotes property sets how the browser should render quotation marks that are automatically added to the HTML q element or added using the open-quotes or close-quotes (or omitted using the no-open-quote and no-close-quote) values of the of the CSS content property.
